reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (official anonymous read-only MCP over public content). Lane `assist` → **keep**; MCP for discovery. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Read-only; licence terms at https://www.gamedev.net/license.xml; replies need an account. - Anonymous read-only MCP with published licence terms; posting stays manual.

reason: GameDev.net publishes its own MCP server (https://www.gamedev.net/developers/mcp/, opened 2026-09-25): Streamable HTTP at https://gamedev.net/mcp/, anonymous and read-only (optional 'Authorization: Bearer gdnet_mcp_<key>' for GameDev Pro), with search_site (content_types e.g. forum_topic), get_thread, get_content and list_recent covering the forums incl. help-wanted threads. No separate REST reference exists; use the official MCP endpoint. Bulk retrieval needs a licence; replies need an account on the site.
